showcase.title: U16 Runtime Bake Query Update Showcase
showcase.playerPerspective: Use the runtime NavData update showcase: pick a route, draw a polygon obstacle on the world or minimap, Update NavData, and read the refreshed NavMesh/HPA/layer overlays.
showcase.modAuthorPerspective: Use this as the Unity/Unreal-style in-game runtime bake acceptance entry: authored polygon, dirty chunks, reload revision, refreshed path query, and the remaining polygon-to-Recast incremental bake gap must all be visible.
